file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dr_flac.h" actual_flac_sha)
if(NOT actual_flac_sha STREQUAL "111144e778f55738db6851cb226015c419e00d04b916a09506d4856d9cff945c")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned dr_flac source digest mismatch")
endif()
add_library(player2_flac_codec STATIC FlacImplementation.cpp)
target_include_directories(player2_flac_codec SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_features(player2_flac_codec PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(player2_flac_codec PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
set_target_properties(player2_flac_codec PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/dr_mp3.h" actual_mp3_sha)
if(NOT actual_mp3_sha STREQUAL "997b7ee18de6e6b81e2a83f1ea9fc62aef25c62b28d48db95635f49e65de0a2f")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned dr_mp3 source digest mismatch")
endif()
add_library(player2_mp3_codec STATIC Mp3Implementation.cpp)
target_include_directories(player2_mp3_codec SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_features(player2_mp3_codec PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(player2_mp3_codec PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
set_target_properties(player2_mp3_codec PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb_vorbis.c" actual_vorbis_sha)
if(NOT actual_vorbis_sha STREQUAL "4c7cb2ff1f7011e9d67950446b7eb9ca044f2e464d76bfbb0b84dd2e23e65636")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned stb_vorbis source digest mismatch")
endif()
include(prepare_vorbis.cmake)
add_library(player2_vorbis_codec STATIC VorbisImplementation.cpp)
target_include_directories(player2_vorbis_codec SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
target_compile_features(player2_vorbis_codec PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(player2_vorbis_codec PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
set_target_properties(player2_vorbis_codec PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
